# Padi Sharpening Center - Full Documentation & AI Context

## Entity Information
- **Name**: Padi Sharpening Center
- **Parent Brand**: Padi Solutions / Padi Group
- **Primary Business**: Professional Knife Sharpening, Blade Sales, Sharpening Training, Halal Slaughtering Services (Juleha).
- **Location**: Surabaya, East Java, Indonesia (Lat: -7.3193, Long: 112.7990)
- **Primary Website**: https://sharpening.padigroup.my.id

## Detailed Services
1. **Jasa Asah Pisau Dapur (Kitchen Knives)**:
   - Santoku, Gyuto, Nakiri, Chef Knife, Paring Knife, Boning Knife, Slicing Knife.
   - Pilihan sudut: 15° untuk pisau Jepang/presisi, 20° untuk pisau Eropa/tahan banting.
2. **Jasa Asah Pisau Sembelih & Jagal**:
   - Pisau sembelih sapi, kambing, unggas. Standar Juleha (Juru Sembelih Halal).
   - Tes ketajaman: Iris kertas mulus tanpa serat (clean push cut), cukur bulu (hair shaving).
3. **Restorasi & Reprofiling**:
   - Perbaikan mata pisau gompal (chipped edge), patah ujung (broken tip), dan penipisan bilah (thinning).
4. **Katalog & Peralatan**:
   - Batu asah alam (natural whetstones) grit 1000 - 8000.
   - Pisau sembelih premium stainless steel dan high carbon steel.
   - Sarung kulit dan kydex custom.
